messages:
Sara_AE: Quick sync — Acme POC moving fast, engineering wants a firm commit and they asked for a 30% discount + SLA on p99 latency for 6 months. Need deal desk routing + a secure-POC clause. Who owns the SF/CPQ fields for this?
James_RevOps: @Natalie_DealDesk I can start the ticket but we need the exact field values to trigger the correct approval path. Thresholds?
Natalie_DealDesk: For discounts >20% or term >3 months we route to Legal + VP Sales. Special_Terms__c should be populated and Deal_Type__c = "POC_COMMIT". Also need Signed_SLA__c = true for the SLA clause.
Liam_CPQ: Ok — CPQ can auto-populate Special_Terms__c from the quote template, but we need the trigger: if Discount__c >= 25 AND Term_Months__c >= 6 then Approval_Level__c = "Exec". Want me to drop the rule?
Sara_AE: Yes please. They asked for 30%/6mo, so that rule would push to Exec which is correct. Also we need a manual override flow if Legal needs more time (can't block POC start).
Natalie_DealDesk: Manual override = Dealdesk_Override__c with Justification__c required. Overrides produce a 24h SLA to respond. If Exec approves via chits in SF, set Override_Approved__c = true.
James_RevOps: Can we capture the override as a quick action in SF and emit a webhook to trigger provisioning? We want POC to start within 48h even if final contract is in flight.
Liam_CPQ: Yes — quick action + outbound change set. Sample action payload below:
```json
{
  "quoteId": "{{Quote.Id}}",
  "override": true,
  "overrideReason": "POC start requested by AE",
  "routing": "dealdesk-override"
}
```
Natalie_DealDesk: Add an audit tag: DD_OVERRIDE_<date> so Finance can reconcile later. Also add a temporary revenue hold flag Temporary_Rev_Hold__c until Legal signs main contract.
Sara_AE: One more: security questionnaire item — they asked for an enclave option and KMS usage. Can we attach a standard SGX/KMS clause template?
Liam_CPQ: We'll attach "sec-poc-template-v2.docx" when Special_Terms__c includes "ENCLAVE_REQUIRED". CPQ will add a checkbox: Enclave_Required__c.
James_RevOps: SLA on approvals: DealDesk responds within 24h to initial requests, Exec responds within 48h. If >48h escalate to CRO. Add escalation rule in SF: if Approval_Status__c = "PendingExec" and CreatedDate > NOW()-48h then escalate.
Natalie_DealDesk: I'll create the approval matrix and a short runbook for AEs: steps, required fields, how to fill Justification__c. Also will add a template response for security Qs.
Sara_AE: Perfect. Can you also list the CPQ field names for the AE playbook? I keep getting different field labels in UI.
Natalie_DealDesk: Copying fields here for the playbook (use API names): Deal_Type__c, Discount__c, Term_Months__c, Special_Terms__c, Enclave_Required__c, Signed_SLA__c, Dealdesk_Override__c, Override_Approved__c, Temporary_Rev_Hold__c, Approval_Level__c
Liam_CPQ: I'll push a minimal managed package with quick actions and the outbound webhook by EOD tomorrow. Deploy-bot will post when ready.
deploy-bot: build succeeded for cpq/quick-actions (artifact cpq-quick-20260320). Release window: nonblocking. :white_check_mark:
Sara_AE: Thanks team — I'll fill the quote with the POC numbers and mark Special_Terms__c="ENCLAVE_REQUIRED;POC_COMMIT" and ping @Natalie_DealDesk if anything changes. :pray:
Natalie_DealDesk: Thanks, Sara. I'll draft the AE playbook and post it here when ready.
